Buy a Singapore Passport on Telegram

The advertised price for a Singapore passport on Telegram usually sits between 130–500 SGD. Anything far below that band is a print and anything far above it should come with a register check you can run yourself.

Issuing authority
the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority
Observed price band

Typical delivery

Local name
passport
Document type
A passport is the travel document a state issues to its own nationals. It is the only document on this site that proves nationality rather than residence or entitlement.

buy singapore passport on telegram – the short version

For a Singapore passport the realistic expectation is 130–500 SGD and one to three weeks of waiting. Same day delivery at the bottom of the band usually means a digital file rather than a card.

Read the price table before you open a chat, not after. Knowing the band stops you anchoring on whatever number the seller opens with.

Buy a Passport via Telegram: how the transaction works

The transaction runs in a private chat, usually after a public channel advert. That is fine. What matters is that the sequence is fixed before money moves: photos first, then a number check, then payment, then tracked delivery.

Some sellers will push for the full amount up front. Offer the deposit and hold firm on the balance. Most accept and the ones who do not are usually reselling stock they do not have.

Who actually issues a Passport

It helps to know that the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority does not sell to the public through Telegram. The chain always ends at that office and the register it keeps is the only authority that counts.

If the seller names a different office, that is not automatically wrong. the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority may delegate. But the answer should be specific enough to be checkable, and vague regional answers are not.

Replica or registered original

The middle tier is stock. The seller has real blank or cancelled stock of the right type and prints onto it, so the physical layer is genuine and the number is invented. Most adverts at the middle of the band are this.

Some sellers will not send a number before a deposit. That is a reasonable position, but the deposit should be small and the number should follow immediately after it.

What a fair price looks like

Treat 130–500 SGD as the market for a Singapore passport and every deviation as a claim to be tested. A high price is a promise of quality, so make the seller keep it.

The honest summary is that you get what the tier buys. Pay the print price for a print, the stock price for stock, and the top price only when somebody proves the number.

The buying process, step by step

Work through these in order. Each step exists because it is where a bad Singapore passport deal usually breaks.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 130–500 SGD band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

The five checks below take minutes and catch almost everything. Two of them are specific to Singapore.

  • Check the licence for the LTA reference and the Singapore category layout.
  • Confirm the national registration number check letter against the published algorithm.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

These end a Singapore passport conversation for good.

  • A registration number whose final letter fails the check letter algorithm.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What should a passport cost on Telegram?

Between 180 and 900 US dollars depending on whether you are buying a print, correct stock, or a number that resolves at the issuing office.

Is a Telegram passport genuine?

Usually not. Most adverts sell a replica or a registered original, and the two are priced very differently. Ask which one it is in writing.

How long does delivery take?

Adverts quote anything from same day to four weeks. A tracked number that moves inside 48 hours is the realistic standard.

Can a passport number be checked?

Only against the issuing office register or an airline check-in system. A seller who offers no route to a register check is selling a print.

What is the most common fake?

A colour photocopy of a real data page laminated into a blank cover with a plausible number typed in.

Before you pay

Print the checklist, run it in order and pay only at the end. That is the whole method for a Singapore passport.
